findings.title: Forced muster toward an appointed source
findings.claim: The gathering and presentation around Hell can also be perceived as a controlled muster: a mixed group is driven together, brought within an encircling site, and made to arrive in ordered succession.
findings.mechanism: The focus forms carry directed gathering, water-side readiness, encirclement, and a raised gathered mass; the pericope's faction, arrival, recurring-turn, and successive-entry occurrences provide the independent herding and source-arrival triggers. Their contact changes a flat crowd into a movement under imposed order.
findings.reader_payoff: The scene acquires a visible procedure: gathering is movement toward a designated place, and the later selection has already been prepared by controlled arrival.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading remains the compelled gathering of humans and devils around Hell. The watering and herd imagery is a bounded contextual resonance; it does not turn Hell into a literal water source or add a separate physical event.

epistemic.reason: The channel nomination is trusted and every branch has a supplied focus or pericope carrier, while the source is still a nomination rather than an adjudicated lexical conclusion.
